query: For refractory high-entropy alloys intended for structural use under extreme-temperature conditions, what single intervention could improve high-temperature oxygen resistance? State one hypothesis that identifies the intervention, explains its mechanism, predicts the improvement relative to the untreated alloy, defines the temperature, atmosphere, and exposure conditions under which it should work, cites supporting prior evidence, and proposes an experiment with a clear result that would falsify the hypothesis.

generation.hypothesis: The addition of Yttrium to refractory high-entropy alloys will improve their high-temperature oxygen resistance by forming a protective oxide layer.
generation.intervention: Addition of Yttrium as an alloying element.
generation.conditions: Exposure to an oxygen-rich atmosphere at temperatures of 1000°C for 100 hours.
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a stable Yttrium oxide layer on the alloy surface.
generation.mechanism: Yttrium reacts with oxygen to form a protective oxide layer that inhibits further oxidation of the underlying alloy.
generation.predicted_outcome: The Yttrium-containing alloy will exhibit significantly lower weight gain due to oxidation compared to the untreated alloy.
generation.baseline: Weight gain due to oxidation of the untreated refractory high-entropy alloy after 100 hours at 1000°C in an oxygen-rich atmosphere.
generation.boundary: The hypothesis is limited to refractory high-entropy alloys and does not account for other alloying elements or different temperature ranges.
generation.uncertainty: The exact improvement in oxidation resistance is uncertain and will depend on the specific composition and microstructure of the alloy.

falsification_experiment.design: Conduct a comparative study of two refractory high-entropy alloys: one with Yttrium and one without, both subjected to the same high-temperature oxidation test.
measurements: Weight gain due to oxidation after 100 hours
Microstructural analysis of the oxide layer
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the Yttrium-containing alloy does not show a statistically significant reduction in weight gain compared to the untreated alloy, the hypothesis will be falsified.
